title: Cubit: Token Mixer with Kernel Ridge Regression
abstract: arXiv:2605.06501v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Since its introduction in 2017, the Transformer has become one of the most widely adopted architectures in modern deep learning. Despite extensive efforts to improve positional encoding, attention mechanisms, and feed-forward networks, the core token-mixing mechanism in Transformers remains attention. In this work, we show that the attention module in Transformers can be interpreted as performing Nadaraya-Watson regression, where it computes similarities between tokens and aggregates the corresponding values accordingly. Motivated by this perspective, we propose Cubit, a potential next-generation architecture that leverages Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR), while the vanilla Transformer relies on Nadaraya-Watson regression. Specifically, Cubit modifies the classical attention computation by incorporating the closed-form solution of KRR, combining value aggregation through kernel similarities with normalization via the inverse of t

translated_title: Cubit：基于核岭回归的令牌混合器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.06501v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：自2017年引入以来，Transformer已成为现代深度学习中最广泛采用的架构之一。尽管在位置编码、注意力机制和前馈网络方面做出了大量改进，但Transformer中的核心令牌混合机制仍然是注意力。在这项工作中，我们表明Transformer中的注意力模块可以解释为执行Nadaraya-Watson回归，即它计算令牌之间的相似性并相应地聚合对应的值。受此视角的启发，我们提出了Cubit，一种潜在的下一代架构，它利用核岭回归（KRR），而普通Transformer依赖于Nadaraya-Watson回归。具体来说，Cubit通过纳入KRR的闭式解来修改经典注意力计算，将基于核相似性的值聚合与通过t的逆矩阵进行的归一化相结合。
tldr: 本论文提出Cubit架构，将Transformer中的注意力机制重新解释为Nadaraya-Watson回归，并创新性地引入核岭回归（KRR）的闭式解来替代传统注意力计算，从而提升令牌混合效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Cubit, a novel architecture that reinterprets Transformer attention as Nadaraya-Watson regression and innovatively replaces it with the closed-form solution of Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) to enhance token mixing.
